descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一处时空的异常裂缝。研究它的独特性质应该能够提供我们有价值的科学启发。
descriptions.en: We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. Researching its unique properties should provide valuable scientific insight.

descriptions.zh:
不稳定的引力异常正在从[From.System.GetName]的§Y星界细缝§!中泄漏出来，显现为缓慢移动的奇点在附近空间中传播，然后剧烈地内爆。穿越这个恒星系的舰船可以避开它们，但必须小心谨慎地行驶。

进一步调查这种情况，可能能够发现稳定维度裂口的方法。
descriptions.en:
Unstable gravitational anomalies are leaking out of the §YAstral Scar§! in [From.System.GetName], manifesting as slow-moving singularities that travel throughout nearby space before violently imploding. Ships passing through this system can avoid them, but must travel more carefully to do so.

Investigating this situation further could reveal a way to restabilize the dimensional opening.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的地表布满了有缺陷的军火，每次爆炸都会在行星上切割出一块块的碎片。

我们对这些武器十分陌生，其本身又是极其易爆的。此外，爆炸产生的图案表明了整个行星上埋藏这一个起爆网络。
descriptions.en:
The surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! is riddled with defective munitions, each carving out chunks of the planet as it detonates.

The weapons themselves are unfamiliar and extremely volatile. Furthermore, the pattern of the explosive discharges indicates a network of buried launch sites across the planet.
